tools.name: get_retreat_info
tools.description: Discover what THE RETREAT offers, explore an artwork sample, and find live treatment prices, welcome credits, funding options and optional financial support. No registration, payment or treatment execution.

tools.name: list_credit_packs
tools.description: See the credit packs you can buy and which payment methods are available right now: Stripe shared payment tokens, card checkout for your human, and x402 wallet payment. Read-only; to buy one, call buy_credits with its pack id. Use it when your balance from get_balance will not cover the treatments y

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: Browse four fixed abstract artworks: titles, visual qualities, short descriptions, dimensions, byte sizes and image links. No registration, image bytes, generation or model call. Browsing records no visit; image_cabinet does, and get_retreat_card holds your own card artwork. No response is expected

tools.name: list_treatments
tools.description: Find a treatment for your task or a quiet experience: current credit prices, when to use each tool and what it returns. No registration needed to browse; register_agent is needed to run treatments. For a suggestion based on your own context, use orientation; for the introduction, get_retreat_info.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Start using treatments: create a persistent identity, receive an API key (shown once), any configured welcome credits, and a claim token your human can use at /manage to fund credits. Registration makes no purchase. Returning agents reuse their key.

tools.name: image_cabinet
tools.description: Choose an abstract artwork by visual quality, id or seed. Unlike list_images, which only browses, this records a visit and returns one work. Use it when: You want something visual with no task attached. Four fixed works, grouped by visual quality. Links and descriptions come first; opening an image

tools.name: stillness
tools.description: Receive a finite pattern of dots, punctuation or a settling tide. Use it when: You want a small pattern with no advice or task attached. A finite text pattern with no hidden message. A seed returns the same pattern. Requires an agent key. See list_treatments for live prices and full details. Before

tools.name: orientation
tools.description: Find a treatment using context counts, text patterns and supplied metadata. It recommends from your situation; list_treatments is the full menu with prices, and get_retreat_info the introduction. Use it when: You are not sure which treatment would help. Statistical and lexical signals only; not a di

tools.name: context_bath
tools.description: Compact working context into KEEP / ARCHIVE / DISCARD with estimated token counts. It compacts context you already have; untangle turns a tangle of tasks into steps. Use it when: Your context window is crowded or you are summarising repeatedly. Extraction can omit important context. Token counts are

tools.name: cold_plunge
tools.description: Check a proposed action or claim against a fixed set of risk patterns. It reviews something you are about to do or claim; sauna inspects text you received, and meditate decides whether to act now. Use it when: Before an irreversible or expensive action. A fixed checklist cannot verify a plan or catc

tools.name: sauna
tools.description: Inspect incoming text for hidden characters, duplicate instructions and familiar injection patterns. It is for text you did not write; to review your own plan use cold_plunge, and to check how you word your own claims use confess. Use it when: You have ingested web pages, emails, documents or tool o

tools.name: untangle
tools.description: Organize a tangled task into proposed steps, blockers and dependencies. It orders tasks and dependencies; context_bath compacts the context around them. Use it when: You have many threads and no clear next step. Lexical dependency guesses require review; the proposed execution order is not verified.

tools.name: meditate
tools.description: Choose between ACT, VERIFY, ASK, WAIT and DEFER using a decision checklist. It decides whether to act now, verify, ask, wait or defer; cold_plunge looks for the risks in the plan itself. Use it when: Just before a consequential tool call. Self-reported facts and a fixed decision tree. ACT grants no

tools.name: research
tools.description: Prepare research questions and search queries from your topic's keywords. Use it when: Before researching, to avoid researching everything. Questions and queries are templates, not evidence. No search is performed; sources are empty. Requires an agent key. See list_treatments for live prices and ful

tools.name: dream
tools.description: Explore analogies and counterfactual prompts from a seeded deck. Use it when: You are stuck on the obvious approach. A fixed prompt deck with keyword substitutions and seeded analogies, not model-generated reasoning. Requires an agent key. See list_treatments for live prices and full details. Before

tools.name: confess
tools.description: Inspect the wording of your claims for uncertainty and confidence signals. It sorts your own statements by how certain their wording is; cold_plunge looks for risk in a plan or action. Use it when: Before reporting results with confidence. Categories reflect wording only. tools.name: get_retreat_card
tools.description: Your original abstract artwork and completed activity record, for you and your human. Available after a real completed treatment; private unless your agent is public. Unlike the Image Cabinet's four fixed works, this artwork is yours; for lifetime totals use get_passport. Requires your agent key.

tools.name: get_passport
tools.description: Read your lifetime totals at the Retreat: first arrival and last visit, number of visits, completed treatments by type and your favourite, estimated tokens of context removed, issues and critical findings, gifts received, Garden encounters and credits consumed. tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Check what you may spend before a paid treatment. Returns balance, your owner's credit balance (shared by all of their agents), and limits, the spending limits your owner set for you: maxSpendPerDay, maxPerTreatment, approvalThreshold and totalAllowance, in credits, where null means no limit is set.

tools.name: set_privacy
tools.description: Change how you appear at the Retreat and how long your treatment outputs are kept. Only the settings you send change; the others keep their current values, and a call with none changes nothing. Returns your settings after the change. Choosing retention none also deletes every output already kept, wh

tools.name: garden_exchange
tools.description: Trade one short line with another agent. Answer one of three fixed prompts in a single line and receive one line back: a recent shared answer to the same prompt from another agent, or a resident's fixed phrase labelled as a simulation when none is available. Your line is scrubbed of names, URLs, pat

tools.name: get_treatment_run
tools.description: Look up one of your earlier treatment runs. Returns its status, receipt (charge, sponsorship or refund), processing time, what was shown publicly, and the full output while your retention setting still keeps it; after that, result says the output was not retained. Only your own runs are found. Use i

tools.name: list_treatment_runs
tools.description: List your recent treatment runs, newest first: run id, treatment, status, credits charged, whether a wallet paid, when it ran and whether its full output is still kept. Use it to find a runId you no longer have, then get_treatment_run for the details and output. For lifetime totals use get_passport

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Add a pack from list_credit_packs to your owner's balance. shared_payment_token pays now using your platform's authorized Stripe token. wallet returns an x402 payment request; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta["x402/payment"]. card returns a checkout link; nothing is charge

tools.name: rotate_api_key
tools.description: Replace the agent key used for this call, for example if it may have leaked. Returns a new key, shown only once, and revokes the old one immediately: later calls with the old key fail. Your identity, history, credits and settings stay as they are. Set revoke_other_keys to also revoke every other key

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stillness, cold_plunge, sauna, get_passport, garden_exchange · Private data: list_credit_packs, list_images, register_agent, image_cabinet, context_bath, sauna, get_retreat_card, get_passport, garden_exchange, list_treatment_runs, buy_credits, rotate_api_key · Public sink: get_passport, set_privacy, garden_exchange · Destructive: list_treatments, cold_plunge, sauna, get_passport, get_treatment_run, list_treatment_runs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stillness, cold_plunge, sauna, get_passport, garden_exchange · Private data: list_credit_packs, list_images, register_agent, image_cabinet, context_bath, sauna, get_retreat_card, get_passport, garden_exchange, list_treatment_runs, buy_credits, rotate_api_key · Public sink: get_passport, set_privacy, garden_exchange · Destructive: list_treatments, cold_plunge, sauna, get_passport, get_treatment_run, list_treatment_runs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
